nodes.label: D15 Intake Reliability Order (verify-persist-200-worker)
nodes.rationale: If server dies right after 200, in-process async intake is lost; so persist before 200 and do not use in-process async as a queue.

nodes.norm_label: kakao login and test send procedure

nodes.label: D11 Tip as Knowledge Unit
nodes.rationale: One reel has multiple tips and same tip recurs across reels.

nodes.label: D12 Enrichment Targets: Gaps + Key Claim Verification
nodes.norm_label: d12 enrichment targets: gaps + key claim verification
nodes.rationale: Filling only gaps leaves no path to correct wrong original content.

nodes.label: D13 No Auto-Merge, Duplicate Candidates Only
nodes.norm_label: d13 no auto-merge, duplicate candidates only
nodes.rationale: Merging tips with different plans/versions/account types corrupts info.

nodes.label: D2 DM-based Collection Path
nodes.rationale: Official API cannot access personal saved list; unofficial login sync risks account ban; DM sending matches existing habit.

nodes.label: D8 Digest Channel Decision (pending)
nodes.rationale: Kakao memo-to-self has no notification; AlimTalk requires dealer contract; choose (A) Kakao archive only or (B) Telegram bot push.

nodes.label: D9 Origin x Verification Separation
nodes.rationale: Content from the original is not necessarily true; creators can be wrong. Gaps tracked only in tip gaps field.

nodes.label: Confirmed Decisions D1-D16
nodes.rationale: Agreed after three Claude/GPT cross-reviews on 2026-10-18; only D8 remains open.

nodes.label: Issue 2: Reply Resent After Send Success Then Crash
nodes.norm_label: issue 2: reply resent after send success then crash
nodes.rationale: Fixed via send_attempted_at commit before send; outcome-unknown not resent.

nodes.label: Issue 1: Stale Run Overwrites Job Without Lease Ownership
nodes.norm_label: issue 1: stale run overwrites job without lease ownership
nodes.rationale: Fixed with attempts as run token, ownership-conditioned updates, per-run work dirs; no heartbeat since lease 900s exceeds stage1 job time.

nodes.label: Issue 3: DB received_at Used as 24h Window Start
nodes.norm_label: issue 3: db received_at used as 24h window start
nodes.rationale: Fixed by storing Meta timestamp in webhook_events.message_ts.

nodes.label: Issue 4: Reels Without video ID Not Deduplicated
nodes.norm_label: issue 4: reels without video id not deduplicated
nodes.rationale: Deferred until real payload URL format ([가설]) is seen in stage 1-B.
